arxiv-1905-03538.description: Abstract . In reactive synthesis, the goal is to automatically generate an implementation from a specification of the reactive and non-terminating input/output behaviours of a system. Specifications are usually modelled as logical formulae or automata over infinite sequences of signals ( ω \omega -words), while implementations are represented as transducers.

arxiv-2012-03479.title: Integration of Few Body Celestial Systems Implementing Explicit Numerical Methods
arxiv-2012-03479.creator: Achilleas Mavrakis, Konstantinos Kritos
arxiv-2012-03479.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Achilleas Mavrakis, Konstantinos Kritos. The N N -body problem is of historical significance because it was the first implementation of the Newtonian dynamical laws for the description of our Solar System. Motivated by this, the project’s goal is to revisit this problem for small N N and find a solution for the trajectories of specific two-body and three-body configurations as well as the planetary orbits of our Solar System using a fourth order Runge-Kutta explicit iterative method.

arxiv-2111-04546.title: Plug&Play subcarrier wave quantum key distribution with deep modulation Journal: oe Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2111-04546.creator: Oleg I. Bannik \authormark 1 and E. S. Moiseev \authormark 1,2,*
arxiv-2111-04546.description: Abstract We report a quantum key distribution using subcarrier wave encoding in Plug&Play configuration. Our detailed study shows how subcarrier encoding operates in a presence of Rayleigh back-scattering, chromatic dispersion and other experimental negative factors that occur in Plug&Play configuration.

arxiv-2210-17074.title: How Spin Relaxes and Dephases in Bulk Halide Perovskites
arxiv-2210-17074.creator: Junqing Xu, Kejun Li, Uyen N. Huynh, Mayada Fadel, Jinsong Huang, Ravishankar Sundararaman, Valy Vardeny, Yuan Ping
arxiv-2210-17074.description: Abstract Spintronics in halide perovskites has drawn significant attention in recent years, due to their highly tunable spin-orbit fields and intriguing interplay with lattice symmetry. Here, we perform first-principles calculations to determine the spin relaxation time ( T 1 T_{1} ) and ensemble spin dephasing time ( T 2 ∗ T_{2}^{*} ) in a prototype halide perovskite, CsPbBr 3 .

arxiv-2307-02316.title: Unintended electromagnetic radiation from Starlink satellites detected with LOFAR between 110 and 188 MHz
arxiv-2307-02316.creator: F. Di Vruno ,, B. Winkel , ⋆, C. G. Bassa , ⋆, G. I. G. Józsa , ⋆, M. A. Brentjens, A. Jessner, S. Garrington , ⋆
arxiv-2307-02316.description: Abstract We report on observations of 68 satellites belonging to the SpaceX Starlink constellation with the LOFAR radio telescope. Radiation associated with Starlink satellites was detected at observing frequencies between 110 and 188 MHz, which is well below the 10.7 to 12.7 GHz radio frequencies used for the downlink communication signals.

arxiv-2308-13689.title: Cubulating infinity in hierarchically hyperbolic spaces
arxiv-2308-13689.creator: Matthew Gentry Durham
arxiv-2308-13689.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Matthew Gentry Durham. We prove that the hierarchical hull of any finite set of interior points, hierarchy rays, and boundary points in a hierarchically hyperbolic space (HHS) is quasi-median quasi-isometric to a CAT(0) cube complex of bounded dimension. Our construction extends and refines a theorem of Behrstock-Hagen-Sisto about modeling hulls of interior points and our previous work with Zalloum on modeling finite sets of rays via limits of these finite models.

arxiv-2311-10695.title: Polarimetric geometric modeling for mm-VLBI observations of black holes
arxiv-2311-10695.creator: Freek Roelofs, Michael D. Johnson, Andrew Chael, Michael Janssen, Maciek Wielgus, Avery E. Broderick, Kazunori Akiyama, Antxon Alberdi, Walter Alef, Juan Carlos Algaba, Richard Anantua, Keiichi Asada, Rebecca Azulay, Uwe Bach, Anne-Kathrin Baczko, David Ball, Mislav Baloković, John Barrett, Michi Ba
arxiv-2311-10695.description: Abstract The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) is a millimeter very-long-baseline interferometry (VLBI) array which has imaged the apparent shadows of the supermassive black holes M87 ∗ and Sagittarius A ∗ . Polarimetric data from these observations contain a wealth of information on the black hole and accretion flow properties.

arxiv-2311-11450.title: Graphene-perovskite fibre photodetectors
arxiv-2311-11450.creator: S. Akhavan, A. Taheri Najafabadi, S. Mignuzzi, M. Abdi Jalebi, A. Ruocco, I. Paradisanos, O. Balci, Z. Andaji-Garmaroudi, I. Goykhman, L. G. Occhipinti, E. Lidorikis, S. D. Stranks, A. C. Ferrari
arxiv-2311-11450.description: Abstract The integration of optoelectronic devices, such as transistors and photodetectors (PDs), into wearables and textiles is of great interest for applications such as healthcare and physiological monitoring. These require flexible/wearable systems adaptable to body motions, thus materials conformable to non-planar surfaces, and able to maintain performance under mechanical distortions.

arxiv-2311-14736.title: Data Diversity Matters for Robust Instruction Tuning
arxiv-2311-14736.creator: Alexander Bukharin 1 , Shiyang Li 2 , Zhengyang Wang 2 , Jingfeng Yang 2 , Bing Yin 2 , Xian Li 2 , Chao Zhang 1,2 , Tuo Zhao 1,2 , Haoming Jiang 2 1 Georgia Institute of Technology, 2 Amazon Correspondence: abukharin3@gatech.edu
arxiv-2311-14736.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alexander Bukharin 1 , Shiyang Li 2 , Zhengyang Wang 2 , Jingfeng Yang 2 , Bing Yin 2 , Xian Li 2 , Chao Zhang 1,2 , Tuo Zhao 1,2 , Haoming Jiang 2 1 Georgia Institute of Technology, 2 Amazon Correspondence: abukharin3@gatech.edu. However, creating such datasets is difficult and most works rely on manual curation or proprietary language models.

arxiv-2403-03716.title: Quantum phase transition between topologically distinct quantum critical points
arxiv-2403-03716.creator: Xue-Jia Yu, Wei-Lin Li
arxiv-2403-03716.description: Abstract By constructing an exactly solvable spin model, we investigate the critical behaviors of transverse field Ising chains interpolated with cluster interactions, which exhibit various types of topologically distinct Ising critical points. Using fidelity susceptibility as an indicator, we establish the global phase diagram, including ferromagnetic, trivial paramagnetic, and symmetry-protected topological phases.

arxiv-2504-02498.title: VISTA: Unsupervised 2D Temporal Dependency Representations for Time Series Anomaly Detection Journal: Pattern Recognition
arxiv-2504-02498.creator: Sinchee Chin, Fan Zhang, Xiaochen Yang, Jing-Hao Xue, Wenming Yang, Peng Jia, Guijin Wang, Luo Yingqun
arxiv-2504-02498.description: Abstract Time Series Anomaly Detection (TSAD) is essential for uncovering rare and potentially harmful events in unlabeled time series data. However, existing methods are highly dependent on clean, high-quality inputs to perform effectively, making them susceptible to noise and real-world imperfections.

arxiv-2505-14049.title: Learning Concept-Driven Logical Rules for Interpretable and Generalizable Medical Image Classification
arxiv-2505-14049.creator: Yibo Gao 1, Hangqi Zhou 1, Zheyao Gao 2, Bomin Wang 1, Shangqi Gao 3, Sihan Wang 1, Xiahai Zhuang 1
arxiv-2505-14049.description: Abstract The pursuit of decision safety in clinical applications highlights the potential of concept-based methods in medical imaging. While these models offer active interpretability, they often suffer from concept leakages , where unintended information within soft concept representations undermines both interpretability and generalizability. Moreover, most concept-based models focus solely on local explanations (instance-level), neglecting the global decision logic (dataset-level).

arxiv-2601-21910.title: Beyond the Finite Variant Property: Extending Symbolic Diffie-Hellman Group Models
arxiv-2601-21910.creator: Sofia Giampietro, Ralf Sasse, David Basin
arxiv-2601-21910.description: Abstract Diffie-Hellman groups are commonly used in cryptographic protocols. While most state-of-the-art, symbolic protocol verifiers support them to some degree, they do not support all mathematical operations possible in these groups. In particular, they lack support for exponent addition, as these tools reason about terms using unification, which is undecidable in the theory describing all Diffie-Hellman operators.

pmc-10517986.title: Tensorial stress-plastic strain fields in α - ω Zr mixture, transformation kinetics, and friction in diamond-anvil cell
pmc-10517986.creator: Valery I Levitas, Achyut Dhar, K K Pandey
pmc-10517986.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Various phenomena (phase transformations (PTs), chemical reactions, microstructure evolution, strength, and friction) under high pressures in diamond-anvil cell are strongly affected by fields of stress and plastic strain tensors. However, they could not be measured. Here, we suggest coupled experimental-analytical-computational approaches utilizing synchrotron X-ray diffraction, to solve an inverse problem and find fields of all components of stress and plastic strain tensors and friction rules before, during, and after α-ω PT in strongly plastically predeformed Zr.

pmc-11477977.title: Utilization of Multiple Recycled Materials in Asphalt Concrete: Mechanical Characterization and Cost–Benefit Analysis
pmc-11477977.creator: Heui-Soo Han, Behnam Golestani, Kyungwon Park, Byounghooi Cho, Boo Hyun Nam, Marek Iwański
pmc-11477977.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study examines the strategic incorporation of various recycled materials into asphalt concrete, specifically focusing on municipal solid waste incineration bottom ash (MSWI BA), recycled asphalt shingle (RAS), and recycled concrete aggregate (RCA). Due to the high porosity of MSWI BA and RCA, and the significant asphalt binder content (30–40%) found in RAS, there is a need to increase the amount of liquid asphalt used.

pmc-11616361.title: Collaborative extended home-visits as a key to facilitating early support within the frame of a family centre in Sweden
pmc-11616361.creator: Marie Golsäter, Ann-Christine Andersson
pmc-11616361.description: BackgroundAll children should have the possibility to be healthy during childhood, according to the Convention on the Rights of the Child. In Sweden, the Child Health Services (CHS) support all parents and children from birth until the age of six to promote children’s health and development.

pmc-11643279.title: Study on the Preparation and Test Method of Transformer Oil Used in Laboratory
pmc-11643279.creator: Zeming Sun, Minxia Shi
pmc-11643279.description: The power transformer is one of the most important parts of a power system. The transformer oil in a transformer not only increases its insulation strength, but also helps its cooling. Cellulose particles are one of the main factors affecting the breakdown characteristics of transformer oil, and the withstand voltage test can effectively detect the quality of transformer oil.

pmc-12522711.title: Genomic diversity and surveillance of SARS-CoV-2 in Nigeria
pmc-12522711.creator: Thomas J Y Kono, Ezenwa J Onyemata, Natalia Blanco, Chika K Onwuamah, Nnaemeka Ndodo, Paul Oluniyi, Olanrewaju Lawal, Christina Riley, Sophia Osawe, Cheryl Baxter, Anna Winters, Chenfeng Xiong, Christian T Happi, Babatunde L Salako, Ifedayo Adetifa, Alash’le Abimiku, Manhattan Charurat, Kristen A St
pmc-12522711.description: BackgroundAs Nigeria has the sixth-highest population in the world and a significant amount of inbound and outbound travel, the characterization of SARS-CoV-2 genomic diversity across the country is critical for understanding novel pandemic dynamics. We describe the genomic diversity of SARS-CoV-2 in Nigeria throughout the COVID-19 pandemic and examine the coverage of Nigeria's genomic surveillance system.

pmc-12652735.title: Silk Fibroin-Derived Smart Living Hydrogels for Regenerative Medicine and Organoid Engineering: Bioactive, Adaptive, and Clinically Translatable Platforms
pmc-12652735.creator: Asim Mushtaq, Khai Ly Do, Abdul Wahab, Muhammad Yousaf, Abdul Rahman, Hamid Hussain, Muhammad Ali, Pingfan Du, Miao Su
pmc-12652735.description: Silk fibroin (SF) has evolved from a traditional biopolymer to a leading regenerative medicine material. Its combination of mechanical strength, biocompatibility, tunable degradation, and molecular adaptability makes SF a unique matrix that is both bioactive and intelligent. Advances in hydrogel engineering have transformed SF from a passive scaffold into a smart, living hydrogel.

pmc-12678887.title: Troponin elevation in supraventricular tachycardia: A narrative review
pmc-12678887.creator: Bülent Özlek, Veysel O Tanık, Süleyman Barutçu
pmc-12678887.description: Supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) is a frequent cause of emergency presentations. Troponin elevation is common, but its clinical significance remains uncertain and may trigger unnecessary downstream testing. In this mini-review, we aimed to review the prevalence, mechanisms, prognostic relevance, and management of troponin elevation in adult paroxysmal SVT.

pmc-12716413.title: Social Media, Health Consciousness, and Cultural Influences on Sugar Reduction Behaviors in Chinese Youth: Extending the Stimulus-Organism-Response Model
pmc-12716413.creator: Bing Hu, Yi Zhu, Ruxiang Bao, Ziying Zhao, Chao Liu, Aomi Lin, Javad Sarvestan
pmc-12716413.description: BackgroundThe rising prevalence of sugar-related diseases, such as obesity and diabetes, has intensified efforts to reduce sugar intake, particularly among youth. In China, social media is playing an increasingly significant role in shaping health behaviors, including habits related to sugar consumption, as sugar reduction has become a prominent youth-led movement.

pmc-13018033.title: Prolactin measurements in a real-life setting: a population-based cohort study
pmc-13018033.creator: Christoffer Krogager, Jens Otto Lunde Jørgensen, Claus Højbjerg Gravholt, Kirstine Stochholm
pmc-13018033.description: PurposeHyperprolactinemia is mainly due to pituitary disorders including prolactinomas but other causes including adverse drug reactions exist. This study aimed to assess the frequency and pattern of serum prolactin measurements in a population-wide cohort in Central Region Denmark (1.32 mill inhabitants) from 2011 to 2022.

pmc-13101832.title: Lateralization of facial recognition in Tibetan and Han individuals: Evidence from eye movement
pmc-13101832.creator: Xingchen Guo, Jialin Ma, Yongxin Li
pmc-13101832.description: In this study, eye movement technology was used to explore the lateralization characteristics of Han and Tibetan individuals when they recognized faces of individuals of their own and other ethnicities. In Experiment 1, the faces were divided into two areas of interest: the left and right sides.

pmc-13329821.title: Ruthenium-based catalysts bearing unsymmetrical NHCs for specific olefin metathesis applications
pmc-13329821.creator: Rida Nadeem, Rubina Troiano, Assunta D'Amato, Consiglia Tedesco, Fabia Grisi
pmc-13329821.description: Novel ruthenium complexes for olefin metathesis incorporating unsymmetrical, backbone-substituted N-heterocyclic carbenes (uNHCs) were synthesised and fully characterised. The effect of NHC backbone configuration (syn or anti), in combination with a pendant N-benzyl substituent and increasingly sterically demanding N′-aryl groups, was systematically evaluated in representative metathesis reactions and in transformations targeting the valorisation of renewable substrates into industrially relevant products.

pmc-13383447.title: Root-oriented replantation with socket reconstruction as a regenerative strategy for periodontally hopeless teeth: a pilot feasibility report
pmc-13383447.creator: Yingman Liu, Haoning Tang, Changjian Li, Xin Zhang, Jing Wang, Yuwei Zhan, Chunhao Yang, Jing Cao, Huan Bian, Yanfeng Li
pmc-13383447.description: BackgroundThis paper describes a technique that the root-oriented replantation (ROR) of periodontally hopeless teeth (PHT) offers the preservation and restoration of tooth stability and function.MethodsPreoperative intraoral three-dimensional (3D) scans and cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) data were imported into the robotic system for virtual surgical planning. During the surgery, the PHT were atraumatically extracted.

pmc-13535444.title: 19 Dissecting ARNT Expression Patterns in RCC and Association with Outcomes
pmc-13535444.creator: Yu-Wei Chen, Shayan Nazari, Andrew Elliott, Ninad Kulkarni, Liliana Ascione, Ali Hajj Ali, Pedro Barata, Brent Rose, Aditya Bagrodia, Neeraj Aggrawal, Sumanta Pal, Toni Choueiri, Rana McKay
pmc-13535444.description: BackgroundHypoxia signaling is a key driver of renal cell carcinoma (RCC) and is mediated by HIF-dependent transcription. ARNT (HIF-1β) is an essential HIF binding partner, but its expression and clinical relevance in RCC are poorly defined. With ARNT inhibitors in development, characterizing ARNT expression in RCC is clinically important.
